describes: rail-stroke.js buildStroke / laneProfile / laneAt / project / unproject
contract: One continuous polyline per part with the lane offset baked in through a triangular-kernel lane profile and its corners rounded; station anchors are the offset of their own vertex and are never trimmed. Pixel space in, pixel space out; the projection is pinned separately.

right angle on a station anchor: the anchor vertex is never rounded
plateau shorter than the kernel is crossed, not held
hairpin reversal stays sharp; exact reversal uses the incoming normal
duplicate vertices collapse and anchors follow the survivor
two-point part: no interior, offset only
one-point part degenerates to a zero-length stroke
no rows, radius 0: the polyline passes through untouched
shallow bends under the fillet floor are left on their vertex
seam jog: a 30 m sideways step is tapered over 150 m either side
seam jog held back by a platform 60 m before it
a jog too small to be a seam (3 m) is left alone
a street S-bend of right angles is not a seam
offset fold: a two-pixel lane on a sub-pixel hairpin curve is unfolded
corridor follow: a weaving stroke is drawn from the canonical alignment, blended in and out
corridor follow against the digitised direction: canonical measures run backwards
mitre limit: a 170° turn offsets by the clamped bisector
